feat(periph): add GPIO, Timer, and UART peripheral emulation

Add three simulated peripherals matching the ANEM16 VHDL hardware:
- GPIO (0xFFD0-0xFFD3): 2 ports, per-bit direction, debug-injectable pins
- Timer (0xFFD7-0xFFDA): prescaler, compare match, auto-reload, interrupts
- UART (0xFFDB-0xFFDE): TX FSM, byte-injection RX, console I/O callback

Integrate into all modes (free-run, debug REPL, JSON-RPC server) with
peripheral clock callback, interrupt OR chain, and debug commands
(gpio, periph, uart tx, gpio.read/write, uart.inject, periph.list).

Fix attachPeripheral off-by-one collision check and zero-initialize
pipeline structs/CPU registers to eliminate pre-existing UB.
